section_title: Case example: Drafting policies for an AFC department based in APAC

propositions.proposition: 因组织活跃于跨境交易，需考虑APAC及其他司法管辖区的法规。
source_quotes: Because his organization will be active in cross-border transactions, he needs to consider regulations and standards within the APAC region as well as other jurisdictions.

candidate_frame.focal_handling_or_judgment: 考虑APAC及其他司法管辖区的法规和标准

evidence_spans.quote: Because his organization will be active in cross-border transactions, he needs to consider regulations and standards within the APAC region as well as other jurisdictions.

propositions.proposition: 因跨境交易涉及美欧，参考美国和欧盟的金融犯罪防控法规。
source_quotes: Hiroshi references the AFC regulations in both the US and EU because some of the cross-border transactions involve those jurisdictions.

trigger_or_context: 跨境交易涉及美国和欧盟
candidate_frame.focal_handling_or_judgment: 参考美国和欧盟的AFC法规

evidence_spans.quote: Hiroshi references the AFC regulations in both the US and EU because some of the cross-border transactions involve those jurisdictions.

propositions.proposition: 因组织从事虚拟资产交易，需考虑相关虚拟资产法规。
source_quotes: And because his organization conducts transactions in virtual assets, he also considers regulations related to this sector.

trigger_or_context: 组织从事虚拟资产交易
candidate_frame.focal_handling_or_judgment: 考虑虚拟资产相关法规

evidence_spans.quote: And because his organization conducts transactions in virtual assets, he also considers regulations related to this sector.

propositions.proposition: 因跨境交易涉及客户数据，必须考虑数据相关法规并纳入政策程序。
source_quotes: Additionally, since cross-border transactions involve customers’ data, Hiroshi must account for data-related regulations in his organization's policies and procedures.

trigger_or_context: 跨境交易涉及客户数据
candidate_frame.focal_handling_or_judgment: 在组织的政策和程序中考虑数据相关法规

evidence_spans.quote: Additionally, since cross-border transactions involve customers’ data, Hiroshi must account for data-related regulations in his organization's policies and procedures.

propositions.proposition: 识别相关法规和监管机构后，确定这些控制将影响的业务产品和服务。
source_quotes: Once Hiroshi has identified the relevant regulations and regulatory authorities to include in his work, he determines which business products and services these controls will affect.

trigger_or_context: 已识别相关法规和监管机构
candidate_frame.focal_handling_or_judgment: 确定受控制的业务产品和服务

evidence_spans.quote: Once Hiroshi has identified the relevant regulations and regulatory authorities to include in his work, he determines which business products and services these controls will affect.

propositions.proposition: 应将持续监管审查的结果适当地纳入其他金融犯罪防控流程，包括全机构风险评估、培训计划和新业务尽职调查。
source_quotes: Hiroshi also mentions that his organization should incorporate the results of ongoing regulatory reviews into other AFC processes as appropriate, including the enterprise-wide risk assessment, training plan, and new business due diligence processes.

candidate_frame.focal_handling_or_judgment: 将审查结果纳入其他AFC流程

evidence_spans.quote: Hiroshi also mentions that his organization should incorporate the results of ongoing regulatory reviews into other AFC processes as appropriate, including the enterprise-wide risk assessment, training plan, and new business due diligence processes.

propositions.proposition: Hiroshi首先自我评估组织面临的金融犯罪风险，询问是否暴露于腐败、欺诈、洗钱或制裁风险，并开始列出相关法律法规，包括客户尽职调查和其他反洗钱标准。
source_quotes: To begin, Hiroshi must understand the financial crime risks his organization will face. He asks himself if his organization is exposed to corruption, fraud, money laundering, or sanctions risks. He also begins listing the laws and regulations that combat these risks, including CDD and other AML standards.

candidate_frame.focal_handling_or_judgment: 自我询问组织是否暴露于腐败、欺诈、洗钱或制裁风险，并列出打击这些风险的法律法规
outcomes_or_paths: 列出客户尽职调查和其他反洗钱标准

evidence_spans.quote: To begin, Hiroshi must understand the financial crime risks his organization will face. He asks himself if his organization is exposed to corruption, fraud, money laundering, or sanctions risks. He also begins listing the laws and regulations that combat these risks, including CDD and other AML standards.

gap_evidence.gap_reason: 已有候选只承接在特定情况下考虑特定司法管辖区法规的动作，未承接初始自我评估风险暴露并列出相关法律法规这一独立动作。

propositions.proposition: Hiroshi在研究中还考虑新兴合规议题，如环境、社会和治理框架以及人工智能在金融犯罪防控中的应用。
source_quotes: Hiroshi's research does not stop there. He also considers emerging compliance topics such as the environmental, social, and governance framework and the use of AI in AFC efforts.

candidate_frame.focal_handling_or_judgment: 考虑新兴合规议题，如ESG框架和AI在AFC工作中的应用

evidence_spans.quote: Hiroshi's research does not stop there. He also considers emerging compliance topics such as the environmental, social, and governance framework and the use of AI in AFC efforts.

gap_evidence.gap_reason: 已有候选未承接考虑ESG和AI等新兴合规议题这一研究扩展动作。
